entries.text: Git workflow: edit files, git status, git add, git commit, git pull, then git push.
Git branches allow isolated lines of development and can be merged later.
GitHub Pages can publish static HTML, CSS and JavaScript sites from a repository.
WordPress themes control presentation while plugins add or modify functionality.
WordPress troubleshooting often starts by checking the exact error, plugin/theme compatibility, PHP version and logs.
JSON should be valid UTF-8 text and can be loaded in JavaScript with fetch and response.json().
